flows.title: Get Fireflies to record a meeting
steps: Turn on auto-join from the Fireflies dashboard to let it join meetings automatically.
Or add fred@fireflies.ai to the Google or Outlook calendar invite.
Or, for a meeting already under way, use the Add to live meeting button on the dashboard: enter the meeting link, set the language and click Start Capturing.

flows.title: Search a meeting transcript
steps: In the Fireflies web app, click Meetings and open the meeting.
Type the words to find in the Search Transcript box and press Enter.
Click the relevant part of the transcript in the results; the recording plays from that point.
Close the search results to follow the transcript along with the playback.

flows.title: Share a meeting recap by link
steps: Click the Meetings tab in the left-hand menu, find the meeting by searching or filtering, and open it.
Click Share in the top-right corner.
In the Share window, choose who can see it from the Privacy dropdown.
Click Copy Link to share the meeting recap directly.
